verdict.rationale: GitLab documents official 'reference architectures' guidance for scaling self-hosted installs (gitlab-docs-11) alongside install tooling like the Linux package (gitlab-docs-9), directly supporting the story's core claim. However, the evidence pack lacks specifics on tiered architectures (e.g., 10k/25k/50k user configs) and community reports of instability/performance issues on GitLab's own infrastructure (gitlab-comm-1, gitlab-comm-4) raise reliability caveats, though these concern GitLab.com SaaS rather than self-hosted reference architectures directly. Missing for 10: detailed tier-by-tier reference architecture specs (node counts, user tiers up to 50k+), and independent validation that self-hosted deployments following these architectures actually scale reliably at that size.
